_comment: Field reference for data/news.json — copy an entry, drop the _comment. Newest entries are shown first (sorted by date). Empty fields are simply not rendered.
title: Entry with everything
text:
The first paragraph of the news entry.

A blank line starts a new paragraph, a single line break stays a line break.

title: Text only
text: Every field except the title is optional — this entry has no image, no link and no video.

title: Linked video
text: A video_url that is not a video file (.mp4 / .webm / .ogv / .mov / .m4v) becomes a 'Watch Video' button instead of an inline player, so nothing is embedded from a third party.
